GRADE 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. distinguish adverbs of manner, time and place for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs.

2. About Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use adverbs of manner, time and place correctly in both oral and written sentences,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs.

3. About Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. distinguish adverbs of manner, time and place for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs.

5. About Writing 9.4.1 Punctuation in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify commonly used punctuation marks in written texts for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 9.4.1 Punctuation completely.
   C. Writing 9.4.1 Punctuation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 9.4.1 Punctuation.

6. About Writing 9.4.1 Punctuation when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use commas and question marks correctly in written texts for clarity of writing,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 9.4.1 Punctuation completely.
   C. Writing 9.4.1 Punctuation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 9.4.1 Punctuation.

7. About Writing 9.4.1 Punctuation while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify commonly used punctuation marks in written texts for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 9.4.1 Punctuation completely.
   C. Writing 9.4.1 Punctuation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 9.4.1 Punctuation.

9. About Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

10. About Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

11. About Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

13. About Pronunciation and Vocabulary in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Pronunciation and Vocabulary using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

14. About Pronunciation and Vocabulary when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Pronunciation and Vocabulary at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

15. About Pronunciation and Vocabulary while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. Pronunciation and Vocabulary helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

17. About Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. read factual texts of about 320 words related to the theme for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading completely.
   C. Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading.

18. About Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. apply appropriate reading habits in reading factual texts of about 320 words for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading completely.
   C. Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading.

19. About Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. read factual texts of about 320 words related to the theme for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading completely.
   C. Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading.

21. About Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify conjunctions correctly in oral and written texts for fluency in speech,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions.

22. About Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. engage in short dialogues featuring conjunctions for fluency in speech,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions.

23. About Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. use conjunctions in a variety of contexts for effective oral and written communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions.

25. About Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the parts of a descriptive composition for self-expression,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing completely.
   C. Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing.

26. About Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. organise thoughts clearly, precisely and creatively into a coherent paragraph for self- expression,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing completely.
   C. Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing.

27. About Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. create a descriptive composition of about 80- 100 words on various topics for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing completely.
   C. Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing.

29. About Listening and speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Listening and speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Listening and speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

30. About Listening and speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Listening and speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Listening and speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

31. About Listening and speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. Listening and speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Listening and speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs in a conversation with a classmate.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Writing 9.4.1 Punctuation in a conversation with a classmate.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary in a conversation with a classmate.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Pronunciation and Vocabulary in a conversation with a classmate.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading in a conversation with a classmate.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions in a conversation with a classmate.

28. Give two examples of how you can use Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing in a conversation with a classmate.
